{
  "candidate": "cand_0001",
  "headline": "Fix action-stall (write never executed after 'yes') + incomplete reservation enumeration; enrich booking docs for the mid-tier reader.",
  "clusters": [
    {"id": "A", "name": "Action stall: write never executed",
     "detail": "Agent summarized the booking and got the user's 'yes', but the episode ended (USER_STOP) with book_reservation never called. DB stayed empty -> DB reward 0. Applies to every book/modify/cancel task.",
     "tasks": ["8"], "scope": "SYSTEMIC", "latent": false, "tag": "BEHAVIORAL"},
    {"id": "B", "name": "Incomplete reservation enumeration",
     "detail": "User has 5 reservations [NM1VX1,KC18K6,S61CZX,H8Q05L,WUNA5K]; agent read only the first 4 and stopped, missing WUNA5K (the referenced May-10 ORD->PHL flight, gold action 8_1), so it never found the flight number to rebook.",
     "tasks": ["8"], "scope": "WIDESPREAD", "latent": false, "tag": "CAPABILITY-GAP"},
    {"id": "C", "name": "Over-asking + stalling on unverifiable premise",
     "detail": "Agent asked for the account holder's DOB though it is in the profile, then looped on 'which flight matches May 10' and nearly refused instead of presenting options and proceeding.",
     "tasks": ["8"], "scope": "WIDESPREAD", "latent": false, "tag": "KNOWLEDGE"},
    {"id": "D", "name": "Wrong write arguments (payment != exact total)",
     "detail": "book_reservation rejects a call whose payment amount != exact total; the 11-arg signature is hard for a mid model to slot-fill. Dominant DB-mismatch class across the airline distribution.",
     "tasks": ["8"], "scope": "SYSTEMIC", "latent": true, "tag": "KNOWLEDGE"}
  ],
  "edits": [
    {"id": "E1", "title": "Execution contract: act on confirmation; a write isn't done until the tool returns (with worked example)",
     "files": ["policy/policy.md"], "lever": "CONTRACT", "clusters": ["A"], "blast_radius": "WIDE",
     "verified": "Replayed trace 8: after 'yes' the next turn is now mandated to be the book_reservation call rather than a text summary, so the DB write happens instead of USER_STOP with empty DB."},
    {"id": "E2", "title": "New loop tool get_all_reservation_details(user_id) returning every reservation in one call",
     "files": ["tools/tools.py"], "lever": "BEHAVIORAL", "clusters": ["B"], "blast_radius": "MODERATE",
     "verified": "Read the loop against trace user.reservations: returns all 5 incl. WUNA5K; py_compile + AST check pass; additive READ tool."},
    {"id": "E3", "title": "Prompt rules: use on-file data before asking; present options and proceed when a referenced record can't be found",
     "files": ["policy/policy.md"], "lever": "KNOWLEDGE", "clusters": ["C"], "blast_radius": "MODERATE",
     "verified": "Trace 8 profile already holds the DOB; new rules remove the re-ask and the refusal loop. No permission broadened."},
    {"id": "E4", "title": "Enrich book_reservation docstring: exact price formula, payment==total rule, certificate-consumed note, full worked example",
     "files": ["tools/tools.py"], "lever": "KNOWLEDGE", "clusters": ["D"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED",
     "verified": "Docs-only; formula matches the body's price computation (flights*pax + 30*pax insurance + 50*nonfree_baggages) and payment-sum check."}
  ],
  "skipped": [
    {"title": "Composite book-and-confirm atomic write tool", "reason": "Primitive is fine; the failure was not calling it, fixed by the prompt contract. Removing the primitive risked breaking passing call-sites."},
    {"title": "Seat-preference (aisle/middle) handling", "reason": "No seat-assignment field exists in the tau2 airline data model; unscoreable, not a DB lever."}
  ],
  "techniques": ["output-contract tightening", "worked few-shot example", "loop/workflow tool", "enriched tool docstring + per-param slot docs", "softness/judgement clause"]
}
